title: Aina, which raised $5.5M, launches an "AI ring" with a screen, joystick, and mic to let users talk to their AI agents, take notes, control Apple TV, and more (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch: Aina, which raised $5.5M, launches an “AI ring” with a screen, joystick, and mic to let users talk to their AI agents, take notes, control Apple TV, and more — Hardware startup Aina released a smart ring today that features a screen, a joystick, and a mic so that you can talk to your agents and take notes.
